target_text:
I agree with the prompt that a positive attitude is the key to success in life. People who have a positive attitude are most successful in their future. There are two reasons why I agree with the prompt.

The first reason I agree with the prompt that positive attitude is the key to success because some people gain positive attitude from others the same way they had a positive attitude towards them. The way you treat people matters in your life, if you treat people with positive attitide the more that person will treat you with a positive attitude. A person who will have a positive attitude can be successful in life.

The second reason I agree with the prompt is that being successful in life

can also earn a person respect from others, the more you respect others by showing your positive attitude the more respect you will earn in your life. Success is the most powerful thing in life, people who are most successful in life will get the most respect from their adults and youngsters. People with positive attitude can have more success in their lives.

In conclusion, I agree that positive attitude can cause success in life. Success is the key to better future. The more you have a positive attitude the more you are successful in life.
